question: Who among the following famous Indian women cricketers announced retirement in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mithali Raj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mithali Raj is an Indian cricketer and a former captain of the Indian women's national cricket team.
 
• She is considered one of the greatest female cricketers of all time and has numerous records to her name.
 
• Mithali Raj announced her retirement from all forms of international cricket in June 2022.
 
• During her career, she scored the most runs in Women's One Day International (ODI) cricket and is the only female cricketer to surpass the 7,000 run mark in Women's ODIs.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smriti Mandhana**

 
 
• Smriti Mandhana is an Indian cricketer and currently one of the leading players in the Indian women's cricket team.
 
• She is known for her aggressive batting style and has been a key player in many of India's victories.
 
• She has won several awards, including the ICC Women's Cricketer of the Year.
 
• As of June 2022, she has not announced her retirement.
 
 
 
• **Jhulan Goswami**
 
 
• Jhulan Goswami is an Indian cricketer and former captain of the Indian women's national cricket team.
 
• She is one of the fastest bowlers in women's cricket and holds the record for the most wickets taken in Women's One Day International cricket.
 
• She has been a crucial part of the Indian bowling attack for many years.
 
• As of June 2022, she has not announced her retirement.
 
 
 
• **Anjum Chopra**
 
 
• Anjum Chopra is a former Indian cricketer and captain of the Indian women's national cricket team.
 
• She has been a significant contributor to women's cricket in India both as a player and as a commentator.
 
• She retired from international cricket in 2012.
 
• Post-retirement, she has been actively involved in cricket commentary and analysis.
